metadata.title: zERC20 Privacy Token Protocol - Remaining Properties Checklist (Batch 2)
metadata.description: Partial audit checklist for non-boundary properties (PROP-021 to PROP-040). This batch covers transfer rejection, Verifier operations, Nova proof validation, teleport flow, and Hub aggregation.

checklist.title: Verify STATE-TRANSFER-REJECTED-VALUE-TOO-LARGE correctly prevents transfers exceeding 2^248-1
checklist.bug_class: Arithmetic Overflow / ZK Circuit Constraint Bypass
detection_procedure: 1. Locate the value validation logic in zERC20 contract (transfer, transferFrom, privateTransfer)
2. Verify MAX_VALUE constant is defined as 2^248 - 1
3. Check that all value inputs are compared against MAX_VALUE before processing
4. Verify rejection path correctly reverts with descriptive error
5. Confirm ZK circuit constraints align with on-chain MAX_VALUE check

executable_checks.assertion: Transfer with value > 2^248-1 must revert
MAX_VALUE constant is correctly defined and used in validation

checklist.notes: Traceability: PROP-021 -> STATE-TRANSFER-REJECTED-VALUE-TOO-LARGE. The 2^248 limit ensures values fit within Nova/Groth16 circuit field constraints. Bypass would corrupt ZK proofs.

checklist.title: Verify STATE-VERIFIER-IDLE represents valid ready state for Verifier operations
detection_procedure: 1. Locate Verifier contract constructor and initialization logic
2. Verify initial state allows hash chain reservations, proof validations, and teleports
3. Check that emergency state correctly blocks normal operations
4. Verify recovery from emergency returns to valid idle state only via admin action
5. Confirm no stuck states exist where Verifier cannot process requests

executable_checks.assertion: Idle Verifier accepts hash chain reservation calls
No locked states or incorrect state guards detected

checklist.notes: Traceability: PROP-022 -> STATE-VERIFIER-IDLE. Base state for all Verifier operations. Emergency mode should be the only valid interruption.

checklist.title: Verify ACTION-VERIFIER-RESERVE-HASH-CHAIN reads authentic hash chain state from trusted zERC20
detection_procedure: 1. Locate reserveHashChain() function in Verifier contract
2. Verify hashChain value is read directly from trusted zERC20 contract address (not user input)
3. Check that zERC20 contract address is immutable or admin-controlled
4. Verify no external parameters influence the hash chain value stored
5. Confirm checkpoint includes sequence number or index for uniqueness

executable_checks.assertion: hashChain read from zERC20.hashChain(), not from calldata
Attacker cannot inject arbitrary hash chain values

checklist.notes: Traceability: PROP-023 -> ACTION-VERIFIER-RESERVE-HASH-CHAIN. Checkpoint binding prevents proof forging. Hash chain must come from trusted source.

checklist.title: Verify STATE-HASH-CHAIN-RESERVED validates checkpoint existence before proof submission
detection_procedure: 1. Locate proof submission function (submitTransferRootProof or similar)
2. Verify checkpoint index parameter is validated against reservedHashChains mapping
3. Check that non-existent checkpoint indices cause revert
4. Verify checkpoint data structure contains both hash chain value and metadata
5. Confirm proof public inputs are bound to the specific checkpoint

executable_checks.assertion: Proof submission with invalid checkpoint index must revert
Checkpoint lookup includes existence validation

checklist.notes: Traceability: PROP-024 -> STATE-HASH-CHAIN-RESERVED. Checkpoint existence is prerequisite for valid proof submission. Missing check allows proof with arbitrary public inputs.

checklist.title: Verify STATE-AWAITING-TRANSFER-ROOT-PROOF requires prior hash chain reservation
detection_procedure: 1. Trace the state machine from reservation to proof submission
2. Verify no code path allows proof validation without associated checkpoint
3. Check that proof submission validates checkpoint was reserved
4. Verify timing constraints (if any) between reservation and proof
5. Confirm state variables correctly track reservation status

executable_checks.assertion: Proof submission without prior reservation must revert
Control flow graph shows reservation check before proof validation

checklist.notes: Traceability: PROP-025 -> STATE-AWAITING-TRANSFER-ROOT-PROOF. Sequential dependency: reservation -> proof. Bypass breaks checkpoint binding.

checklist.title: Verify ACTION-VERIFIER-VALIDATE-NOVA-PROOF uses correct public inputs from reserved checkpoint
checklist.bug_class: Proof Verification Bypass / Public Input Manipulation
detection_procedure: 1. Locate IRootDecider.verifyOpaqueNovaProof() call in Verifier
2. Verify public inputs include the reserved hash chain checkpoint
3. Check that public inputs are sourced from storage, not user-provided
4. Verify decider contract address is immutable or admin-controlled
5. Confirm proof verification failure causes revert, not silent continue

executable_checks.assertion: Invalid Nova proof must be rejected with revert
Public inputs derived from reserved checkpoint, not calldata

checklist.notes: Traceability: PROP-026 -> ACTION-VERIFIER-VALIDATE-NOVA-PROOF. Core cryptographic verification. Groth16 soundness depends on correct public input binding.

checklist.title: Verify STATE-TRANSFER-ROOT-PROVED only reachable via successful Nova proof verification
detection_procedure: 1. Locate provedTransferRoots mapping storage
2. Trace all code paths that write to this mapping
3. Verify only successful verifyOpaqueNovaProof() call leads to root storage
4. Check for any admin bypass functions that could store roots directly
5. Verify failed verification leads to revert or emergency, never to root storage

executable_checks.assertion: Root stored only after successful proof verification
No unguarded paths to root storage

checklist.notes: Traceability: PROP-027 -> STATE-TRANSFER-ROOT-PROVED. Critical state - roots enable teleport withdrawals. Unauthorized root storage = fund theft.

checklist.title: Verify STATE-EMERGENCY-TRIGGERED activates only on genuine divergent proof detection
checklist.bug_class: Denial of Service / Emergency Trigger Manipulation
detection_procedure: 1. Locate divergent proof detection logic in Verifier
2. Verify comparison logic: same index, different root
3. Check that false positives cannot occur (same root at same index is not divergent)
4. Verify emergency mode blocks normal operations correctly
5. Confirm only admin can recover from emergency state

executable_checks.assertion: Same index with different root triggers emergency
Same root at same index does not trigger emergency

checklist.notes: Traceability: PROP-028 -> STATE-EMERGENCY-TRIGGERED. Defense mechanism. False triggers cause DoS; missed triggers allow protocol inconsistency exploitation.

checklist.title: Verify STATE-AWAITING-TELEPORT-PROOF enforces sequential validation flow
detection_procedure: 1. Locate teleport() function entry point in Verifier
2. Trace execution path through all four validations: root -> recipient -> monotonicity -> proof
3. Verify each validation step must pass before proceeding to next
4. Check that no shortcut path exists to teleport execution
5. Confirm validation order is enforced (not reorderable)

executable_checks.assertion: Teleport requires all validation steps in sequence
All four validations present and sequential

checklist.notes: Traceability: PROP-029 -> STATE-AWAITING-TELEPORT-PROOF. Entry point for withdrawals. Missing any validation = fund theft vector.

checklist.title: Verify ACTION-VERIFIER-VALIDATE-ROOT-REFERENCE checks root existence in proved/global mappings
detection_procedure: 1. Locate root validation logic in teleport flow
2. Verify root is checked against provedTransferRoots (local) and globalTransferRoots (cross-chain)
3. Check that non-existent roots return zero and are rejected
4. Verify attacker-provided roots that don't match storage are rejected
5. Confirm root lookup uses correct mapping keys

executable_checks.assertion: Teleport with non-existent root must revert
Root lookup validates existence before use

checklist.notes: Traceability: PROP-030 -> ACTION-VERIFIER-VALIDATE-ROOT-REFERENCE. First teleport validation. Fabricated root = unauthorized withdrawal.

checklist.title: Verify ACTION-VERIFIER-VALIDATE-RECIPIENT-HASH binds recipient to proof public inputs
detection_procedure: 1. Locate recipient hash validation in teleport flow
2. Verify on-chain recipient address is hashed and compared to proof public input
3. Check hash function matches what's used in ZK circuit (likely Poseidon)
4. Verify msg.sender or explicit recipient parameter is validated
5. Confirm mismatch causes revert

executable_checks.assertion: Teleport to different recipient than proof must revert
Recipient hash computed and compared to public input

checklist.notes: Traceability: PROP-031 -> ACTION-VERIFIER-VALIDATE-RECIPIENT-HASH. Prevents fund redirection. Hash binding in proof commits recipient.

checklist.title: Verify ACTION-VERIFIER-CHECK-MONOTONICITY prevents double-spend via strict increasing totalTeleported
detection_procedure: 1. Locate totalTeleported validation logic in Verifier
2. Verify strict inequality: newTotalTeleported > storedTotalTeleported
3. Check that equality (replay with same value) is rejected
4. Verify storage update happens atomically after all validations
5. Confirm no path allows teleport without monotonicity check

executable_checks.assertion: Same proof submitted twice must fail on second attempt
newTotalTeleported must be > storedTotalTeleported

checklist.notes: Traceability: PROP-032 -> ACTION-VERIFIER-CHECK-MONOTONICITY. PRIMARY double-spend prevention. Bypass = unlimited minting.

checklist.title: Verify ACTION-VERIFIER-VALIDATE-WITHDRAWAL-PROOF cryptographically validates Groth16 proof
detection_procedure: 1. Locate withdrawal proof verification call (withdrawLocal/withdrawGlobal decider)
2. Verify BN254 pairing check is performed on proof elements
3. Check that verification keys are immutable or admin-controlled
4. Verify public inputs include root, recipient hash, and amounts
5. Confirm verification failure causes revert, not silent pass

executable_checks.assertion: Invalid Groth16 proof must be rejected
Groth16 verification with correct public inputs

checklist.notes: Traceability: PROP-033 -> ACTION-VERIFIER-VALIDATE-WITHDRAWAL-PROOF. Core cryptographic security. Proof forgery = unlimited minting.

checklist.title: Verify ACTION-VERIFIER-CALL-TELEPORT uses exact delta amount from verified proof
detection_procedure: 1. Locate teleport() call to zERC20 contract
2. Verify amount parameter is extracted from verified proof public inputs
3. Check that amount cannot be modified between verification and call
4. Verify delta calculation: amount = newTotal - oldTotal from proof
5. Confirm no external parameter influences the minted amount

executable_checks.assertion: Minted amount equals delta from proof public inputs
Mint amount sourced from verified proof, not calldata

checklist.notes: Traceability: PROP-034 -> ACTION-VERIFIER-CALL-TELEPORT. Final minting step. Amount must match proof delta exactly.

checklist.title: Verify STATE-TELEPORT-COMPLETE requires all four validation steps
detection_procedure: 1. Trace successful teleport execution path end-to-end
2. Verify state transition to complete only after: root + recipient + monotonicity + proof validations
3. Check that success event is emitted only on complete path
4. Verify no admin override can reach completion without validations
5. Confirm atomic execution (all-or-nothing)

executable_checks.assertion: Teleport completion requires all 4 validations
No shortcuts to teleport completion

checklist.notes: Traceability: PROP-035 -> STATE-TELEPORT-COMPLETE. Terminal success state. Reaching this without full validation = protocol compromise.

checklist.title: Verify STATE-TELEPORT-REJECTED catches all invalid teleport attempts correctly
detection_procedure: 1. Enumerate all rejection paths: invalid root, bad recipient, non-monotonic, invalid proof
2. Verify each rejection returns specific error for debugging
3. Check that valid teleports are never incorrectly rejected
4. Verify state remains unchanged on rejection (no partial updates)
5. Confirm rejection is deterministic and reproducible

executable_checks.assertion: Invalid root reference correctly rejected
Valid teleport is not incorrectly rejected

checklist.notes: Traceability: PROP-036 -> STATE-TELEPORT-REJECTED. Failure state with multiple incoming edges. Both false rejection and false acceptance are bugs.

checklist.title: Verify ACTION-VERIFIER-RELAY-ROOT only sends proved roots to Hub via LayerZero
detection_procedure: 1. Locate LayerZero send function in Verifier (likely _lzSend)
2. Verify root value sent is from provedTransferRoots storage
3. Check that relay only happens after STATE-TRANSFER-ROOT-PROVED
4. Verify message format includes chain ID and other identifying info
5. Confirm no external parameter can modify relayed root value

executable_checks.assertion: Only proved roots can be relayed to Hub
Relayed root sourced from proved storage

checklist.notes: Traceability: PROP-037 -> ACTION-VERIFIER-RELAY-ROOT. Cross-chain trust anchor. Unproved root relay = global state corruption.

checklist.title: Verify STATE-ROOT-RELAYED handles LayerZero delivery guarantees correctly
detection_procedure: 1. Verify LayerZero integration follows best practices for message reliability
2. Check for retry mechanisms on failed deliveries
3. Verify event emission for tracking relay status
4. Check guardian configuration (13/19 supermajority)
5. Assess impact of message loss on protocol state

executable_checks.assertion: LayerZero integration follows OApp patterns
Message retry mechanism exists for failed deliveries

checklist.notes: Traceability: PROP-038 -> STATE-ROOT-RELAYED. External LayerZero dependency. Message loss doesn't cause fund loss but may block cross-chain teleports.

checklist.title: Verify STATE-HUB-IDLE only accepts roots from registered Verifiers
detection_procedure: 1. Locate Hub contract's _lzReceive callback
2. Verify source EID validation against registered peer list
3. Check peer registration is admin-only
4. Verify unknown EIDs cause message rejection
5. Confirm no bypass path for unregistered sources

executable_checks.assertion: Hub rejects messages from unregistered EIDs
Source validation before processing

checklist.notes: Traceability: PROP-039 -> STATE-HUB-IDLE. Central aggregation point. Accepting rogue roots = protocol compromise.

checklist.title: Verify ACTION-HUB-RECEIVE-ROOT validates source EID before payload processing
detection_procedure: 1. Locate payload decoding in Hub _lzReceive
2. Verify EID check happens BEFORE payload decoding/processing
3. Check that invalid EID causes immediate revert
4. Verify peer list cannot be modified by non-admin
5. Confirm root storage only happens after successful validation

executable_checks.assertion: EID validation precedes payload processing
No reentrancy in receive flow

checklist.notes: Traceability: PROP-040 -> ACTION-HUB-RECEIVE-ROOT. CRITICAL: Source validation is the only defense against rogue root injection. Must happen before any processing.
